record.issue_text: AddGuestsDialog.tsx:59 — isInvalidEmail is only cleared by the Cancel button; closing via overlay/Escape (onOpenChange) or a successful add leaves the error banner and stale emails for the next open

adjudication.rationale: In AddGuestsDialog, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on validation failure in `handleAdd`, but it is only reset to `false` in the Cancel button handler. The dialog can be closed via `Dialog`'s `onOpenChange={setIsOpenDialog}` (overlay click / Escape), which does not reset `isInvalidEmail` (or `multiEmailValue`). Also, the mutation `onSuccess` closes the dialog and resets `multiEmailValue` to `[""]` but does not reset `isInvalidEmail`, so if the user previously triggered the invalid banner and then successfully adds guests, the banner state will remain `true` and will show again on next open. The claim about stale emails after a successful add is not accurate because `onSuccess` clears `multiEmailValue`, but stale values do persist when closing via overlay/Escape.
